description: This file defines a utility enum 'GatewayPayloadDecoding' with static methods for decoding JSON payloads into Swift Decodable types, including optional decoding. It serves as a helper for decoding payload data, utilizing Foundation's JSONEncoder and JSONDecoder.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an AnyCodable payload into a Decodable type T, encoding the payload to JSON data and then decoding it.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Decodes an optional AnyCodable payload into an optional Decodable type T, returning nil if the payload is nil.
